title: Shadow Lost
description:
What dark and twisted things are happening in the strange town?

With the arrival of the protagonist, the answer gradually surfaced!



Game plot:

You will control the protagonist to come to a mysterious village chief and reveal the terrible secret unknown here! Players need to find clues to escape from here!

Content and gameplay

-Search for props hidden in every corner of the map

-Fight against mutant zombies

-Rich decryption elements

-Complete props and weapon system

-Explore the vast map

Game features:

-Real and exciting game mode with first-person perspective.

-Tense and scary game atmosphere.

-Solve the terrible truth about the village.
description_short: What dark and twisted things are happening in the strange town?
